4. This parameter represents the pad leakage of the I/O itself. The total product pad leakage is provided by the following formula: I = 10 μA + [number of I/Os where V is applied on the pad] ₓ I .
5. V must be lower than Max(V ) + 3.6 V. IN DDXXX
6. The pull-up and pull-down resistors are designed with a true resistance in series with a switchable PMOS/NMOS. This PMOS/NMOS contribution to the series resistance is minimal (~10%).
